entities.title: ZAZZLE_LLM_DIR
entities.summary: Where zazzle-llm keeps its models and defaults.
entities.scope: Read by zazzle-llm on every command.
entities.details: Holds `models/` (installed GGUF files, `.FILE.part` partial downloads and `.FILE.lock` lock files) and `defaults` (`model=` and `effort=` lines written by `llm`). Directories are created with mode 0700.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_LLM_LOG
entities.summary: Shows llama.cpp's own log on standard error when set.
entities.scope: Read by the engine when a prompt runs.

entities.title: Default model and effort
entities.summary: The model and effort `prompt` uses when it is given neither, set with `zazzle agent llm --model NAME --effort E`.
entities.type: model name and one of low, medium, high
entities.validation: An effort that is not low, medium or high in the file is read as medium; an unknown model name fails when used.
